title: Attorney General Mendonça Pledges Impartiality in Master Bank and INSS Fraud Cases
detail: Brazil's Attorney General Jorge Messias Mendonça pledged to handle the high-profile Master bank and INSS pension fraud cases impartially, drawing comparisons to the need to avoid the procedural errors that plagued the Lava Jato operation. The cases are among the most politically sensitive legal proceedings in Brazil ahead of the 2026 elections.
